cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: What Are We Now?
cards.instruction: Find out how someone defines the relationship without directly asking for a label.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I taught you to plan these trips. For your sister's wedding, shall I book us one room or two?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you've remembered the budget. Now the detail you always miss: a double bed or twins?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Twins. I don't want to confuse things.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Clear instructions at last. At breakfast, do I sit with your family or wait in the lobby? I taught you to plan where everyone belongs.

reason: Make A teaching behavior shape the pursuit rather than detach from the relationship, preserving concrete stakes and responsive partner contributions.
